yijing-64gua v1.0.0

- Initial release with binary decoding logic for 易经64卦 analysis.
- Supports decoding 6-digit sequences to primary and resulting hexagrams.
- Provides lookup table for all 4096 possible hexagram variants.
- Includes core 易经 hexagram data and calendar/record files.
- Enables CSV-based querying and storage structure for future expansion.
